text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I was watching over the Umamusume training,
Hishi Amazon called out to me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hey you!
Have you seen Sky anywhere?
choice_data_list: No, I haven't seen it, but……
No, I haven't seen it, but……

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I see.
...Looks like she ran off during
supplementary lessons again.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: That's why, as the Miho dorm head, I figured I ought to teach them a lesson.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, there she is! Sky!
Now then, how should I catch her?
choice_data_list: Let's do a pincer movement and catch them.
Let's guide them to the grounds.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I suggested that rather than chasing them head-on,
a pincer movement would likely be far more effective.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Fair point.
I'll get the Miho Dorm folks to lend a hand
and catch her in no time!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Whoooaaa---!!
Big Sis Amazon won't let you slack off!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky seemed prepared for a pincer attack, but against a three- or four-layer Umamusume containment cordon, she finally threw in the towel.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: This incident served as a wake-up call for Seiun Sky, and perhaps even turned out to be a good form of training in its own right.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I suggested that by herding Seiun Sky toward the track and continuing to chase her down, it would serve as impromptu tandem training.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
So you don't necessarily have to catch 'em, huh?
……All right, count me in!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heyyyy, Sky!!
Get back here right noooow!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The game of tag with Hishi Amazon and the others continued
for a while, and Seiun Sky was supposedly deeply frustrated
once she realized what they were up to.
